name: Fiberon PA612-ESD @BBL A1
filament_notes:
Fiberon manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 100 C for 10 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed 8 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
ABRASIVE: fit a hardened nozzle on this printer first.
Warp-Free nylon: keep build plate AND ambient air below 50 C (open chamber doors); no enclosure. All-metal hotend + hardened/ruby nozzle (brass nozzle life ~9 h per TDS). Very hygroscopic: print from a heated dryer, store <20% RH. TDS chamber temperature: 'Room Temp.' Moisture-condition parts after annealing. Surface resistivity drops with higher nozzle temp (280->320 C). HDT 157 C @0.45 MPa. Not UL94 V0. Black; 0.5 kg and 3 kg on shop (wiki FAQ also mentions 1 kg). Fan OFF (TDS Z specimens 80%). Support: PolySupport for PA12.
Source: https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0548/7299/7945/files/TDS_FIBERON_PA612-ESD_V1.0_EN.pdf?v=1750452542
